_comment: All Discord-facing bot messages. Edit any value freely. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the bot.
server_already_running:
**Server is already running.** 🟢
> Use `/status` to check the current player count and idle timer.
server_already_starting:
**Server is already starting up.** ⚙️
> Please wait — use `/status` to check progress once it's online.
server_starting:
**Starting server…** ⚙️
> Console output will begin appearing in this channel shortly.
> Use `/status` once it's online to confirm.
server_start_failed:
**Failed to start the server.** ❌
> ```{error}```
> Check your `config.json` paths and ensure the start script is accessible.
server_shutting_down_wait:
**Server is finishing its shutdown.** ⏳
> Please wait a moment, then try `/run` again.
server_not_running:
**No active server to stop.** ⚪
> Use `/run` to start one.
server_stop_sent:
**Shutdown command sent.** ⏹️
> The server is saving and closing. This may take a moment.
server_stop_failed:
**Could not reach the server process.** ⚠️
> It may have already stopped or crashed. Check the console channel for details.
status_offline:
**Server Status** — Offline 🔴
> No active instance is running. Use `/run` to start the server.
status_online:
**Server Status** — Online 🟢
> 👥  **{online} / {maximum}** players online — {players}
> 📶  Latency: `{latency} ms`
> ⏱️  Idle timer: `{idle} / {timeout} min`
status_starting:
**Server Status** — Starting 🟡
> The process is running but the server isn't accepting connections yet.
> Try again in a moment.
cmd_not_sent:
**Command not sent.** ❌
> The server is not currently running. Use `/run` to start it first.
idle_warning:
**Idle Warning** ⏱️
> No players have been online for a while.
> The server will automatically shut down in **{time_left} minute{plural}** to save resources.
> Join now to keep it running.
player_joined:
**Player connected.** 🟢
> The idle shutdown timer has been reset.
auto_shutdown:
**Auto-Shutdown Triggered** 🔴
> The server has been idle too long with no players online.
> Shutting down now to conserve resources. Use `/run` to restart when needed.
server_online_announce:
**Server is Online** 🟢
> The Minecraft server has started and is ready for players.
> 🔗  Connect at `{ip}`
server_offline_announce:
**Server is Offline** 🔴
> The server has shut down. Use `/run` whenever you want to play again.
